# endpointcentral_mdm_group_membership (Resource)

Adds one device to an MDM group. Non-authoritative: other members are left alone. The device gets every profile assigned to the group. Find device IDs with the `endpointcentral_mdm_device` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "endpointcentral_mdm_group" "macos_dev" {
  name = "macos-dev"
}

data "endpointcentral_mdm_device" "studio" {
  serial_number = "C02XYZ123"
}

# One device per resource; other members are left alone.
resource "endpointcentral_mdm_group_membership" "studio" {
  group_id  = endpointcentral_mdm_group.macos_dev.id
  device_id = data.endpointcentral_mdm_device.studio.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (String) device ID.
- `group_id` (String) MDM group ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<group_id>/<device_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <group_id>/<device_id>
tofu import endpointcentral_mdm_group_membership.studio 200000000114014/200000000112017
```
